pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly shaped polygonal dark regions with moderately smooth edge gradients; spatial area is maximal on the mid-flank and decreases significantly toward the posterior and ventral regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light cream negative-space graph with clearly defined tri-point and tetra-point junction nodes. Corridor thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank and maintains continuity across the visible torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane exhibits a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the cervical and thoracic ridge, appearing as a consistent dark brown fringe against the background.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Localized area of grey-white textural disruption and crusting on the upper-mid flank, resulting in a loss of definition between the patches and corridors.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive region of epidermal scaling and light-colored textural anomalies on the lateral flank, consistent with chronic skin lesions.
